name: work-journal
description: Daily, weekly and monthly reviews of your work in Claude Code, summarized from the prompts you typed: projects, threads, decisions and open items. /journal opens it in a pane, /journal web as a webpage.

excludeProjects.title: Projects to leave out
excludeProjects.description: Comma-separated parts of project paths to skip, e.g. client-x, secret. Their prompts are never read or summarized.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the summaries.
